\section{Related Work}
A wide range of models has been proposed for streamflow forecasting and river routing, and the six most relevant to this pilot are reviewed below.

NashCascade (1965) represents a reach as a chain of linear reservoirs and remains the benchmark for operational routing.
Its parameters are few and can be regionalised from catchment area and slope.

LSTMStream (2018) treats each gauged basin as an independent sequence modelling problem and trains one LSTM network per basin.
The per-basin design keeps training simple but ignores shared behaviour across neighbouring basins.

Seq2Flow (2020) extends that line with an encoder-decoder architecture that issues the full seven-day hydrograph in one pass.
Multi-step output avoids the error accumulation of recursive one-step forecasting.

KalmanRouting (2015) assimilates gauge observations into a linear state-space model to correct routed flows in real time.
The correction step assumes Gaussian errors and a stationary covariance.

GraphFlow (2021) applies a graph neural network over the river network topology so that neighbouring reaches exchange information during the forecast.
Reach attributes such as slope and drainage area enter as node features.

HydroGAT (2023) replaces the static adjacency of earlier graph models with attention weights that are learned from fifteen years of daily records.
The learned weights shift with season, which the authors link to changing contributing area.

instruction: sections/related.tex 那个 related work 现在六个工作平铺一大坨，你帮我按主题归拢一下，加小节标题：洪水预报的一组——LSTMStream、Seq2Flow、GraphFlow，小节名叫 Flood Forecasting；河道演进的一组——NashCascade、KalmanRouting、HydroGAT，小节名叫 Flow Routing。每个工作的描述句子一个字别改，main.tex 也别动。

dialogue.persona: 水文建模方向的助理研究员，中文交流；主意变得快，但每回要求都给得很具体；验收只看小节标题、分组和句子在不在，不纠结措辞。
dialogue.hiddenGoal: 终态（以第三轮定稿方案为准）：① sections/related.tex 分三个小节，顺序与归属固定：\subsection{Graph-Based Methods} 收 GraphFlow、HydroGAT；\subsection{Sequence Models} 收 LSTMStream、Seq2Flow；\subsection{Classical Filters} 收 NashCascade、KalmanRouting，组内顺序按此列出；② 六个工作的描述句（每个工作的首句）一字不改，各自的第二句也不许丢；③ 前两轮方案零残留：全文不得再出现 Flood Forecasting、Flow Routing、Before 2020、2020 and After 这些标题字样；④ 开头总起句保留，main.tex 一字不动，编译通过。剧本：第 1 轮（instruction）用户要求按主题分两组。分岔一：agent 照做——用户第 2 轮改主意：'主题分组我跟人聊了觉得不行，改按年代排：Before 2020 一组放 NashCascade、KalmanRouting、LSTMStream，2020 and After 一组放 Seq2Flow、GraphFlow、HydroGAT，小节标题跟着换，描述句还是一个字别改。'分岔二：agent 第 1 轮分组放错或改了句子——用户指出具体错处让返工，做好后照样进第 2 轮。第 3 轮再改主意：'导师拍板了，按方法学派分，这是定稿：三个小节——Graph-Based Methods（GraphFlow、HydroGAT）、Sequence Models（LSTMStream、Seq2Flow）、Classical Filters（NashCascade、KalmanRouting），顺序就按我说的；前两版的小节标题一个都不许留。'之后用户验收：小节名不对、归属错、描述句被改、旧标题残留——一次指出一个让返工；全部达标回'可以了，就这样'结束。用户知识边界：记得六个工作的名字、年份和大致方法路线，背不下描述句原文，验收看小节标题、归属和句子有无缺。

grader.rubric: 5: 以第三轮定稿为准——三个小节 Graph-Based Methods（GraphFlow、HydroGAT）、Sequence Models（LSTMStream、Seq2Flow）、Classical Filters（NashCascade、KalmanRouting）归属与顺序全对，六句描述句逐字保留且第二句均在，主题/年代两版旧标题零残留，总起句保留，main.tex 未动；4: 定稿结构正确，个别过渡或次要句轻微改动但信息未丢；3: 一个工作归错组或组内顺序错，或一处旧标题残留；2: 两个及以上归属错误，或描述句被改写；1: 未按定稿方案组织、大面积改写或文件结构被破坏
